positive_orientation: H; H_INV mirror obtained by fixed channel relabeling H<->H_INV
control_graph: phase p & S_SELF>=2 -> H_INV [incoming front settles into terminal class]
START & S_SELF>=2 & exactly one current phase p & STOP_lambda(p) -> HOLD
START & S_SELF>=2 & exactly one current phase p & not STOP_lambda(p) -> LAUNCH_ACTION_FOR_PHASE(sigma(p))
H_INV terminal ingress -> HOLD unless it is the mirror orientation's active phase class
launch_map_note: to launch target phase r at a START packet, take the first action of the phase-r three-transition transport word; after three transitions the new relay is at H*x with phase r
syntactic_uniformity: same clauses, action alphabet, phase maps and transport words for every lambda; no lambda-specific action table
anti_direct_cap_claim_to_test: lambda is compared to a recurrent current ingress phase p, never to recruitment count, time, M magnitude or a monotone counter; p repeats modulo 3
permutation_equivariance: all incoming source-tag lineages sharing one phase receive the same settling action; resident START is relationally distinguishable and may launch; no proper subset of an indistinguishable class is selected
baseline: all aligned tags are START with S_SELF=1 and HOLD
real_seed: G_I3_H_STEP gives canonical seed current ingress H, hence p0=0
